title: Lego-based Therapy
summary: A programme designed to support children with social communication difficulties.
details:
- Initial chat and getting to know you session – 30-60 mins
- Approximately 8-12 weeks, 1-hour sessions
- Programme is designed to support children with social communication difficulties. It encourages turn taking, sharing, listening, team-work and problem solving.
- Parents/carers or an additional sibling can be involved in the course if required (at no additional cost).
